title: A 3D Cell Culture Model Identifies Wnt/β‐Catenin Mediated Inhibition of p53 as a Critical Step during Human Hepatocyte Regeneration

evidence_spans.quote: Here, a 3D spheroid model of PHH is established to study hepatocyte regeneration
primary human hepatocytes (PHH)
its proliferative senescence-inducing target PAI1 (SERPINE1)
integrative time-lapse multi-omics analyses

scope_reviewer.uncertainty_reason: The report names a senescence-inducing target but reports hepatocyte regeneration and proliferation rather than directly measuring, inducing, reversing, or comparing a senescent state. It also uses only a generic multi-omics label without naming currently used molecular layers.
scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This is an empirical study in human hepatocytes. Cellular senescence is not explicitly analyzed as a state, so aging relevance and role are unclear; the generic multi-omics wording leaves the distinct molecular layers unresolved.

causal_design_reviewer.outcome: inhibition of p53 and PAI1 (SERPINE1), and hepatocyte proliferation
